source.title: Cambridge B1 Preliminary for Schools Trainer · Exam Practice
source.selection: B1+–B2 useful vocabulary appearing on original Exam Practice pages; examples and explanations created for learning.

words.definition: during the night
words.example: Heavy snow fell overnight and blocked the road.
words.cloze: Heavy snow fell ________ and blocked the road.

words.definition: a period of waiting because something is late
words.example: The train delay made us miss the meeting.
words.cloze: The train ________ made us miss the meeting.

words.definition: a line of vehicles that cannot move freely
words.example: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.
words.cloze: We were stuck in a ________ for an hour.

words.definition: a group of sports teams competing against each other
words.example: Our school team won the local football league.
words.cloze: Our school team won the local football ________.

words.definition: visual or sound tricks used in films
words.example: The film uses special effects to create huge monsters.
words.cloze: The film uses ________ to create huge monsters.

words.definition: allowing people to take part and respond
words.example: The museum has an interactive video exhibition.
words.cloze: The museum has an ________ video exhibition.

words.definition: background objects or a setting used in a play or film
words.example: The film studio built realistic scenery for the city scene.
words.cloze: The film studio built realistic ________ for the city scene.

words.definition: clothes worn for acting or a special event
words.example: The actor wore a colourful costume in the film.
words.cloze: The actor wore a colourful ________ in the film.

words.definition: looking or seeming like real life
words.example: The studio created a realistic model of a dinosaur.
words.cloze: The studio created a ________ model of a dinosaur.

words.definition: an object kept to remember a place or visit
words.example: I bought a souvenir after visiting the film studio.
words.cloze: I bought a ________ after visiting the film studio.

words.definition: appearing in a film or on a screen
words.example: Her on-screen character was a friendly monster.
words.cloze: Her ________ character was a friendly monster.

words.definition: near or around a particular place
words.example: We explored the surrounding area after the tour.
words.cloze: We explored the ________ area after the tour.

words.definition: to go somewhere with another person
words.example: A guide will accompany visitors around the studios.
words.cloze: A guide will ________ visitors around the studios.

words.definition: stories about imagined future science or technology
words.example: My brother loves science fiction films about space.
words.cloze: My brother loves ________ films about space.

words.definition: a method used to record or create a film
words.example: The documentary explains a clever filming technique.
words.cloze: The documentary explains a clever ________.

words.definition: difficult in an interesting or demanding way
words.example: The climbing course was challenging but enjoyable.
words.cloze: The climbing course was ________ but enjoyable.

words.definition: a person who teaches a practical skill
words.example: Our instructor explained how to use the equipment.
words.cloze: Our ________ explained how to use the equipment.

words.definition: to register to take part in an activity
words.example: She decided to sign up for the coasteering course.
words.cloze: She decided to ________ for the coasteering course.

words.definition: to travel around a place to learn about it
words.example: We hope to explore the caves along the coast.
words.cloze: We hope to ________ the caves along the coast.

words.definition: a large natural hole in a hill or rock
words.example: The group entered a cave near the beach.
words.cloze: The group entered a ________ near the beach.

words.definition: a hard hat that protects your head
words.example: You must wear a helmet when climbing the rocks.
words.cloze: You must wear a ________ when climbing the rocks.

words.definition: a tight suit worn in cold water
words.example: He borrowed a wetsuit before entering the sea.
words.cloze: He borrowed a ________ before entering the sea.

words.definition: to give someone confidence or support
words.example: The instructor tried to encourage nervous beginners.
words.cloze: The instructor tried to ________ nervous beginners.

words.definition: a high, steep face of rock
words.example: They stood safely at the top of the cliff.
words.cloze: They stood safely at the top of the ________.
